snippet.title: Legendary Hoplite - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Add Legendary Hoplite to your wishlist: https://ravenage.ink/3hNGMzB

A combination of Tower Defense and Action RPG: slay monsters, hunt weapons, upgrade your armies, defend your base. Prevent humanity from extinction before the threat of Greek Mythology monsters and ancient tribes.
